# snipeit_hardware_audit_due (Data Source)

Lists assets that are due (or nearly due) for audit.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "snipeit_hardware_audit_due" "due" {}

output "assets_due_for_audit" {
  value = [for a in data.snipeit_hardware_audit_due.due.assets : a.asset_tag]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `assets` (Attributes List) Matching assets. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--assets))
- `total` (Number) Total number of matching assets.
